title: vert.x-web kotlin application fails on intellij 2019.3 ad win 10 1909
body:
**Describe the bug**
downloaded a maven+kotlin skel. from code.quarkus.io. It is a REST config with RestEasy + vert.x-web. Running the code as is returns no problem. I've substituted the default "ExampleResource.kt" with a "hello world" from the vert.x-web kotlin guide:
```
package org.acme

import io.vertx.ext.web.Router

class Server : io.vertx.core.AbstractVerticle() {
    override fun start() {
        var server = vertx.createHttpServer()

        var router = Router.router(vertx)

        router.route().handler { routingContext ->

            // This handler will be called for every request
            var response = routingContext.response()
            response.putHeader("content-type", "text/plain")

            // Write to the response and end it
            response.end("Hello Worlds from Vert.x-Web!")
        }

        server.requestHandler(router).listen(8080)
    }
}
```
and the system blames me for targeting JVM 1.6, but JVM 1.8 is targeted in the pom.xml file

**Expected behavior**
It is expected to see the code run both in dev and in package and serve a static hello world (text/plain) page on the browser in localhost

**Actual behavior**
either in dev or in package run, maven fails with the following message:

>  Failed to execute goal org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-maven-plugin:1.3.61:compile (compile) on project vert.x-skel: Compilation failure
[ERROR] C:\Users\XXX\IdeaProjects\vert.x-quarkus-skel\src\main\kotlin\org\acme\ExampleResource.kt:[9,29] Calls to static methods in Java interfaces are prohibited in JVM target 1.6. Recompile with '-jvm-target 1.8'

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. download a MAVEN+Kotlin project where you add vert.x-web to the default RESTEasy
2. substitute the default "hello world" with the one in the vert.x-web kotlin docs
3. run the app under intellij 2019.03 community on Win 10 64 bit

**Configuration**
```properties
I attach my pom.xml, nothing added in the application.properties or similar
```
[this is my pom](https://gist.github.com/absinthetized/f27fa6a6b36e45b56280bc053657428d) (nothing chenged from the original, downloaded from code.quarkus.io)
